text:
Scrambled eggs and a spinach salad on a square plate. The plate is probably about 24-26 cm across.

The eggs cover roughly 10x8 cm and are fairly thick, so I estimate about 110 g. Scrambled eggs with some added fat run about 1.6 kcal/g, which gives roughly 175 kcal.

The salad is spinach, carrot shreds, and cucumber, about 40 g. With a little dressing it comes to about 30 kcal.

Total: about 150 g and about 205 kcal.
